metadata.description: Claude Code skills for PHP work: Laravel Blade apps, Laravel REST APIs, simple native PHP + MySQL sites, and deploying to shared hosting (cPanel / hPanel). Simple, clean, secure code — no over-engineering.

plugins.name: laravel-blade
plugins.description: Server-rendered Laravel: Blade + Bootstrap + vanilla JS, FormRequests, flash toasts, auth with laravel/ui, media uploads with image optimization.

plugins.name: laravel-api
plugins.description: Laravel REST APIs: one JSON envelope, FormRequests, API Resources, Sanctum tokens, role middleware, transactions with row locks.

plugins.name: native-php
plugins.description: Simple native PHP + MySQL sites: page-per-file, PDO prepared statements, CSRF, sessions, flash messages, safe uploads.

plugins.name: shared-hosting-deploy
plugins.description: Deploy Laravel or native PHP to shared hosting (cPanel / Hostinger hPanel) without exposing .env, plus the common traps and a launch checklist.
